mapper.sql: s.id, s.title, s.report_type, s.content, s.status, s.emp_id, s.dept_id, s.wf_instance_id, s.create_time, s.update_time, e.real_name AS emp_name, dp.dept_name
FROM doc_sign_reports s LEFT JOIN sys_employee e ON s.emp_id = e.id AND e.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN sys_dept dp ON s.dept_id = dp.id AND dp.del_flag = '0' WHERE s.del_flag = '0'
